items.title: Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum Review: Hyaluronic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: a long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration, suitable for all skin types and especially dry or dehydrated skin.
items.hook: a long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration.
facts: Long-lasting serum that kick-starts skin's hydration cycle and immediately floods skin with hydration (10 ml, 30 ml and 59 ml)
Suitable for all skin types, especially dryness or dehydration, dullness, fine lines or loss of firmness
Enhanced form of hyaluronic acid penetrates the skin's surface for deep hydration
Polyglutamic acid from fermented soy replenishes skin's hydration reserves from within
Smooth over cleansed face and neck morning and night, after toning and before moisturizing; about 4-6 drops
Sensitive skin: you may want to patch test first

scenes.caption: Circular Hydration Serum
scenes.say: Is your skin feeling dry, dull or tight, even when you moisturize? Today we're looking at the Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: what it does, what's in it, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Floods skin with hydration
scenes.say: This is a long-lasting serum made to kick-start your skin's hydration cycle. It immediately floods the skin with hydration.

scenes.caption: Who it's for
scenes.say: It's suitable for all skin types, and especially for you if you have dryness or dehydration, dullness, fine lines, or loss of firmness.

scenes.caption: Three benefits
scenes.say: There are three main benefits. It immediately hydrates to quench dehydrated skin. It gives hydration that lasts through the day and beyond. And it replenishes skin from within.

scenes.caption: Hyaluronic acid
scenes.say: The first key ingredient is hyaluronic acid. This serum uses an enhanced form of hyaluronic acid that penetrates the skin's surface for deep hydration.

scenes.caption: Polyglutamic acid
scenes.say: The second is polyglutamic acid, from fermented soy. It replenishes the skin's hydration reserves from within.

scenes.caption: Step 1: cleanse
scenes.say: Now, how to use it. Start with clean skin. Cleanse your face and neck first.

scenes.caption: Step 2: tone
scenes.say: Next, tone. The serum goes on after your toner and before your moisturizer.

scenes.caption: 4 to 6 drops
scenes.say: Use a small amount. Around four to six drops can cover the face and neck for most people.

scenes.caption: Face and neck
scenes.say: Smooth it over your face and neck. There's no need to rub hard; just spread it evenly.

scenes.caption: Then moisturize
scenes.say: Then follow with your moisturizer. The serum goes on first, and your moisturizer goes on top.

scenes.caption: Morning and night
scenes.say: Use it twice a day, morning and night, as part of your regular routine. It's made to give hydration that lasts throughout the day.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin
scenes.say: If you have sensitive skin, you can use it, but you may want to patch test first. Some people may notice a subtle scent from the botanical ingredients.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: It comes in ten, thirty and fifty-nine milliliter sizes. So that's the Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: hyaluronic acid and polyglutamic acid for hydration that lasts. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica MultiVitamin Power Recovery Masque Review: Vitamins A, C and E, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica MultiVitamin Power Recovery Masque: an ultra-replenishing masque that helps rescue stressed, aging skin, recommended for all skin types, especially dry or dehydrated skin.
items.hook: an ultra-replenishing masque that helps rescue stressed, aging skin.
facts: Ultra-replenishing masque that helps rescue stressed, aging skin (15 ml and 75 ml)
For all skin types, especially dry or dehydrated skin, dullness, uneven tone and uneven texture
Concentrated vitamins A, C and E and linoleic acid help restore skin showing signs of damage and aging
Algae extract helps moisturize and soften; pro-vitamin B5 helps nourish; licorice, comfrey and burdock extracts soothe and calm
Apply generously to cleansed face and throat, avoiding the eyes; rinse with warm water after 10 to 15 minutes; once a week
Reactive skin: patch test a small area first

scenes.caption: MultiVitamin Power Recovery Masque
scenes.say: Has your skin been looking dull, dry or stressed lately? Today we're looking at the Dermalogica MultiVitamin Power Recovery Masque: what it does, what's in it, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Ultra-replenishing masque
scenes.say: This is an ultra-replenishing masque that helps rescue stressed, aging skin. It's a restorative masque for skin exposed to stress.

scenes.caption: Who it's for
scenes.say: It's recommended for all skin types, especially dry or dehydrated skin, dullness, uneven tone and uneven texture.

scenes.caption: Vitamins A, C and E
scenes.say: Here's what's inside. Concentrated vitamins A, C and E, plus linoleic acid, help restore skin showing signs of damage and aging.

scenes.caption: Antioxidant vitamins
scenes.say: Antioxidant vitamins C and E help shield the skin from free radicals, and the masque helps repair daily damage triggered by them.

scenes.caption: Algae + pro-vitamin B5
scenes.say: Algae extract helps moisturize and soften the skin, while pro-vitamin B5 helps nourish damaged skin.

scenes.caption: Licorice, comfrey, burdock
scenes.say: Botanical extracts of licorice, comfrey and burdock soothe and calm the skin, while increasing resilience.

scenes.caption: Texture
scenes.say: The texture is rich, creamy and silky. It spreads smoothly and can partly dry to a light film.

scenes.caption: Step 1: cleanse
scenes.say: Now, how to use it. Start by cleansing your face, so the masque goes onto clean skin.

scenes.caption: Apply generously
scenes.say: Apply the masque generously to your face and throat, and keep it away from the eye area. You can also use it on the neck and chest.

scenes.caption: 10 to 15 minutes
scenes.say: Leave it on for ten to fifteen minutes, then rinse it off gently but thoroughly with warm water. Take your time so none of it is left on the skin.

scenes.caption: Then SPF or moisturizer
scenes.say: Follow with Dynamic Skin Recovery SPF50 or your Dermalogica moisturizer.

scenes.caption: Once a week
scenes.say: Use it once a week, or whenever your skin needs a soothing remedy. If your skin is reactive, do a small patch test before using it on your whole face.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: It comes in fifteen and seventy-five milliliter tubes. So that's the Dermalogica MultiVitamin Power Recovery Masque: vitamins A, C and E for stressed, dull, dry skin. The link is in the description.
